turns.prompt: Which smartwatch works with iPhone and lasts at least two weeks on a charge, under $200?
turns.answer:
Yes. There are several good options under $200 that work with iPhones and offer at least 14 days of advertised battery life.

My top recommendations are Amazfit Bip 6 for everyday use and Garmin Forerunner 55 for fitness and running.

One important distinction: These watches work with iPhones, but they don't offer the same level of integration as an Apple Watch. Some messaging and third-party app features will be limited.
